text.en: Dog owners praise Agnes for her compassionate, dedicated, and deeply intuitive approach to canine behaviour. Reviewers highlight her ability to understand each dog's distinct temperament and guide owners patiently through training routines. Clients value her holistic methods and thoughtful support, describing her as an encouraging teacher and trusted advisor.

Pet parents report clear, lasting behavioural improvements following consultations and multi-week training programs. Reviewers cite noticeable reductions in puppy separation anxiety, improved calmness during loud fireworks, and reduced stress-related skin scratching. Several clients note that practical exercises yielded visible positive changes within days.

Clients emphasize Agnes's focus on animal emotional welfare, noting her use of gentle routines and Bach flower remedies alongside behavioural training. Owners appreciate that she works in harmony with dogs suffering from grief, anxiety, or noise phobias. Reviewers feel their relationship with their pets became significantly stronger and more harmonious.

q.en: What training issues does PawsAgnes specialize in?

a.en: Reviews highlight specialized support for separation anxiety, puppy obedience, reactive behaviour, fear of fireworks, and emotional distress.

q.en: Are consultations suitable for first-time dog owners?

a.en: Yes, clients note that Agnes offers pre-adoption advice and structured puppy programs that guide new owners in building confidence and understanding canine body language.

q.en: What methods are used during training sessions?

a.en: Agnes combines practical behavioural techniques with holistic approaches, including Bach flower remedies and emotional calming methods tailored to each pet.

q.en: How long does it typically take to see behavioural changes?

a.en: Multiple reviewers report noticing positive shifts in puppy calmness within a few days of implementing the recommended exercises.
